name: winter_barley

source.t_base_c: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 1.1: Tbase 0 degC.
source.t_upper_c: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 1.1: Tupper 15 degC (as printed; the wheat annex has 26).

source.stages: [D] emergence 141, stem_elongation 1318, heading 1606, maturity 2171, overripe 2427 are development units accumulated by the Python port of the model's thermal-time rule (clamped daily Tmin/Tmax, Tbase/Tupper above) along the Frankfurt/Main daily record (DWD station 01420), 1992-2024, from the year's mean sowing date to the year's mean date of the DWD phase (annual reporters of all German stations, quality level <= 3; DWD CDC opendata phenology/annual_reporters/crops), averaged over 32 seasons (DWD winter barley phases 12 Auflaufen BBCH 10, 15 Schossen BBCH 31, 18 Aehrenschieben BBCH 51, 21 Gelbreife BBCH 87, 24 Ernte; sd of the seasons 13/85/89/100/103 units; mean doys sowing 263.8, emergence 275.4, BBCH 31 106.7, heading 133.0, yellow ripe 176.1, harvest 194.0). Flowering 1700 [AS]: BBCH 65 is not observed; barley flowers at about heading (about 90 units later). Senescence 1850 [AS]: start of canopy decline, inside the annex range emergence + 900-2000 and about 40 units after flowering ends.

source.cc0_cm2_per_plant: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 1.2: soil surface covered by an individual seedling 1.50 cm2/plant.
source.plant_density_per_ha: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 1.2: 1 500 000 - 3 000 000 plants per hectare (management); 2.4 million is German practice (about 300 seeds/m2 drilled, 80 % emerging), inside the range.
source.ccx: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 1.2: maximum canopy cover 50-99 % (management); 0.95 inside the range.
source.cgc_per_gdd: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 1.2: canopy growth coefficient 0.008 per GDD.
source.cdc_per_gdd: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 1.2: canopy decline coefficient 0.006 per GDD.
source.senescence_acceleration: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: extra senescence progress per unit of senescence stress (1 - Ks_sen); the model's own device (AquaCrop shifts the senescence start instead).)

source.kc_tr_x: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 2: KcTr,x 1.10.
source.height_max_m: [C] FAO-56 Table 12 (fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm): barley maximum crop height 1 m.
source.p_depletion: [C] FAO-56 Table 22 (fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0e.htm): barley p = 0.55 at ETc ~ 5 mm/day, rooting depth 1.0-1.5 m.
source.p_adjust_for_etc: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: FAO-56 Table 22 note: p = p_table + 0.04 (5 - ETc), limited to 0.1-0.8 (the limits are in the code as the note's own range).)
source.exp_p_upper: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 4.1: canopy expansion 0.20.
source.exp_p_lower: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 4.1: canopy expansion 0.65.
source.exp_shape: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 4.1: shape factor for canopy expansion 3.0.
source.sen_p_upper: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 4.1: canopy senescence psen 0.55.
source.sen_shape: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 4.1: shape factor for canopy senescence 3.0.

source.wp_star_g_m2: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 3.1: WP* 15.0 g/m2.
source.gdd_full: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 4.2: minimum growing degrees for full biomass production 14 degC day.
source.rue_g_mj: [AS] 1.1 g/MJ of global radiation as for wheat; Gallagher and Biscoe 1978 (J. Agric. Sci. 91:47-60) treat wheat and barley with the same RUE (about 2.2 g/MJ PAR), recalled for barley, not looked up.
source.rue_t_low_c: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: ramp of the light-use efficiency over the daily mean air temperature: 0 at and below this value, 1 at rue_t_full_c. Form: linear ramp as in the SIMPLE crop model (Zhao et al. 2019, Eur. J. Agron. 104:97-106; read in a code port, not the paper). Both values fitted (F1d part 1) so that the aboveground biomass at BBCH 31 falls from 6.7 t/ha to about 4 t/ha without the harvest falling by more than 15 )
source.rue_t_full_c: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: see rue_t_low_c.)
source.light_primary: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: 1: the daily gain is the light potential x Tr/Tr_potential (the water factor of the AquaCrop gain, Tr = transpiration, Tr_potential = Kcb x ET0), WP* is then not used for the gain. 0: the smaller of the light potential and WP* x Tr/ET0. With 0 and the ramp below the harvest was 14 % under the DESTATIS mean at the same BBCH 31 biomass (F1d part 1); with 1 the same early biomass keeps the yield, bec)
source.co2_response: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), chapter 3, Table 3.11c/1 (Eq. 3.11c): multiplier of WP* for a C3 crop (f_type = 1) over the atmospheric CO2 concentration, the FACE-based column (fsink 0); WP* is normalised to 369.41 ppm (the year 2000). Applied to WP* and, as photosynthesis, to rue. The crop's f_type = clamp((40 - WP*)/20, 0, 1) (Eq. 3.11d).)

source.hi0: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 3.2: reference harvest index 30-50 % (cultivar); 0.45 for a modern German variety, inside the range.
source.hi_build_gdd: [D] development units from the flowering stage to maturity of the stage table (2171 - 1700).
source.flowering_length_gdd: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 1.3: length of the flowering stage 150-250 GDD; 200 inside the range.
source.excess_fruits_pct: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 3.2 lists 'medium' without a number; 50 % is the value of the manual's own worked example (AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12, Fig. 3.12i).)
source.ppol: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 4.1: pollination fails above a depletion of 0.85 of TAW.
source.sto_coefficient_b: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: coefficient b of the negative effect of stomatal closure during yield formation (AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12, Eq. 3.12m/n: 1 = strong effect .. 20 = small effect); Annex I.10 section 3.2 gives only 'moderate' for wheat. 7 (recalled default crop file) is inside the range. The functional form (HI factor = mean of 1 - (1 - Ks_sto^(1/10))/b) is [C];)
source.cold_t_c: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 4.2: cold stress for pollination below 5 degC.
source.cold_width_k: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12, section 3.12.5: cold pollination coefficient reaches 0 five degrees below the threshold.)
source.heat_t_c: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.11 Barley, section 4.2: heat stress for pollination above 35 degC.
source.heat_width_k: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12, section 3.12.5: heat pollination coefficient reaches 0 five degrees above the threshold (F1a had a 6 K width).)
source.logistic_steepness: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: the manual says the temperature Ks curves are logistic (section 3.2.3) but prints no equation; this is the steepness of a logistic rescaled to hit 0 and 1 at the limits.)
source.straw_harvest_fraction: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: straw:grain ratio 0.8; with the harvest index 0.45 the harvestable straw is 0.8 x 0.45 = 0.36 of the biomass out of the non-grain 0.55; 0.36/0.55 = 0.655.

source.zr_min_m: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 1.4: minimum effective rooting depth 0.30 m.)
source.zr_max_m: [C] FAO-56 Table 22: barley maximum rooting depth 1.0-1.5 m (upper end); AquaCrop allows up to 2.50 m (management).
source.gdd_full: [AS] development units from sowing at which the maximum depth is reached (before flowering).

source.kill_onset_c: [AS] daily minimum at which frost starts to kill an emerged stand; winter barley is less frost-hardy than winter wheat (LT50 about -10 to -15 degC, recalled).
source.kill_full_c: [AS] daily minimum at which the whole stand is killed.
source.snow_insulation_swe_mm: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: snow water equivalent above which snow shields the stand.)
source.snow_floor_c: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: lowest temperature the stand sees under that snow.)

source.harvest_window_days: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: days after maturity before the grain starts to shed.)
source.shed_rate_per_day: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: fraction of the remaining grain lost per day afterwards.)

source.nc_a: [AS] Justes et al. 1994 wheat curve Nc = 5.35 W^-0.442 used for barley; no barley-specific curve was looked up.
source.nc_b: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: Justes, Mary, Meynard, Machet, Thelier-Huche 1994, Ann. Bot. 74:397-407 (value from a search summary of the abstract, not the paper))
source.nc_w_min_t_ha: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: Justes, Mary, Meynard, Machet, Thelier-Huche 1994, Ann. Bot. 74:397-407 (value from a search summary of the abstract, not the paper): below 1.55 t/ha a constant 4.4 % is suggested.)
source.nc_const_pct: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: Justes, Mary, Meynard, Machet, Thelier-Huche 1994, Ann. Bot. 74:397-407 (value from a search summary of the abstract, not the paper))
source.n_min_conc_pct: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: N concentration at which growth stops.)
source.n_stress_start_t_ha: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: the N factor applies once the aboveground dry matter exceeds this.)
source.n_uptake_max_kg_ha_day: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: maximum daily N uptake.)
source.n_uptake_frac_per_day: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: share of the available soil mineral N the roots can take per day.)
source.n_residual_kg_ha: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: soil mineral N the roots cannot take.)
source.n_root_fraction: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: root N as a fraction of the aboveground N.)
source.n_grain_share: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: Winterbraugerste/Wintergerste grain 2.11 kg N/dt, straw 0.50 kg/dt, ratio 0.8; grain/(grain + 0.40/0.655).
source.n_fixation_fraction: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: cereals do not fix nitrogen.)
source.p2o5_conc_pct_dm: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: total aboveground P2O5 per t fresh grain over the aboveground dry matter 0.86/0.45 t.
source.p2o5_grain_share: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: grain 0.80, straw 0.30 kg P2O5/dt, ratio 0.8.
source.k2o_conc_pct_dm: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: as p2o5_conc_pct_dm for K2O.
source.k2o_grain_share: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: grain 0.55, straw 1.40 kg K2O/dt, ratio 0.8.
source.ph_opt_low: [AS] pH (CaCl2) from which barley is unrestricted; barley is the more lime-demanding cereal (extension advice, recalled).
source.ph_opt_high: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: )
source.ph_floor: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: pH at which the factor is ph_floor_factor.)
source.ph_floor_factor: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: )

source.lodging_nmin_full_kg_ha: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: ... and at which the loss is lodging_max_loss.)
source.lodging_max_loss: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: share of the grain lost at the full lodging risk.)
source.lodging_bbch_from: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: window of the stem elongation to flowering stages in which surplus N makes the stand lodge.)
source.lodging_bbch_to: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: )

source.root_dm_fraction: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: root dry matter as a share of the aboveground dry matter at harvest; cereal root:shoot at maturity is about 0.1-0.2 (recalled).)
source.root_upper_share: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: share of the root residue in the top 0.10 m of the 0.30 m management layers.)
source.seed_mass_g: [D] thousand-kernel weight 42 g, the middle of 38-46 g of German winter barley varieties.
source.seed_viability: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: germination capacity of drilled seed (the German seed law minimum is 85 %, certified lots are above 92 %).)
source.depth_opt_min_m: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: the recommended drilling depth of winter wheat is 2-4 cm (extension advice, recalled).)
source.depth_opt_max_m: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: see depth_opt_min_m.)
source.depth_zero_m: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: emergence fails from about 10 cm (the coleoptile of modern semi-dwarf wheats is short).)
source.depth_surface_factor: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: emergence of seed lying on the surface (birds, drying) relative to the optimum depth.)
source.seedbed_floor: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: emergence factor of the worst seedbed; field emergence of drilled wheat is typically 75-85 % of the seeds, which this reproduces together with seed_viability.)
source.residue_emergence_penalty: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: emergence lost at full residue cover for a tool with residue_tolerance 0.)
source.germ_wet_min: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: wetness of the evaporation layer (1 - De/TEW) below which the seed does not germinate.)
source.germ_wet_full: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: wetness from which germination runs at full rate.)
source.dry_hazard_per_day: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: share of the sown seed that dies per day in a seed layer below germ_wet_min.)
source.compensation_density_m2: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for winter_barley, not crop-specific (wheat entry: constant d0 of the yield-density law 1 - exp(-d/d0) (Willey and Heath 1969 form); wheat compensates thin stands by tillering, 100 plants/m2 give about 92 % of the 250 plants/m2 reference.)

source: F1d winter barley (family cereal with wheat: both are hosts of take-all and eyespot, see the pathogen notes of the F1d report). Annex I.11 Barley values of the AquaCrop reference manual v7.3 are [C]; the stage table is [D] from DWD phenology and the Frankfurt station; nutrient removal is [D] from LfL Bayern Bas22; whatever else is [AS] says so. No vernalisation is modelled (the crop is only sown in autumn; a spring sowing of this file would skip the cold requirement).
